items.title: Live: Trump says Iran 'afraid' to admit it wants a deal as US sends in more troops
items.description: Donald Trump claims Iranian leaders are afraid to admit they are negotiating with the US, with the Pentagon confirming the deployment of more ground troops to the Middle East. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Over 300 petrol stations out of diesel, PM says 'nowhere is immune' to global crisis
items.description: During Question Time, Anthony Albanese faced a grilling on the impacts of war in the Middle East. Follow live.

items.title: States to seek consistent reporting of fuel shortages at national cabinet
items.description: State and territory leaders are also expected to push for a national approach to any further measures including fuel rationing if supply were to run short.

items.title: Lift minimum wage above the rate of inflation, federal government urges
items.description: In its submission to the Fair Work Commission's annual wage review, the government again calls for the lowest-paid workers to not go backwards.

items.title: Vegetable growers won't plant more crops if costs keep rising
items.description: A snap survey by AUSVEG reveals 27 per cent of Australian vegetable growers have already reduced planting, while some will not harvest current crops because rising costs make it unviable.

items.title: TGA proposes removing sunscreen SPF numbers in regulation changes
items.description: The proposals include a number of changes to SPF testing requirements, oversight of the labs that do SPF testing, and the way SPF is labelled — reforms that would overhaul the sunscreen industry.

items.title: Live: Authorities give update as Cyclone Narelle nears WA coast
items.description: Authorities in Western Australia say they are preparing for weather not seen since 2021.

items.title: Queensland man charged over alleged plans to fight in Myanmar civil war
items.description: Police allege Attilio Ivor Filip Dallavalle travelled to Thailand in January with plans to travel onward to Myanmar to engage in "hostile activities" with an armed group engaged in the ongoing conflict.

items.title: 'My left foot was in his mouth': Fisher's lucky escape from 3.5m shark
items.description: A fisher known as "Lucky Luke" to his mates lives up to his nickname after surviving a great white shark dragging him along the ocean floor while lobster fishing off the South Australian coast.

items.title: Drug-fuelled driver who hit schoolboys sues Commonwealth over arrest
items.description: Tayler Hazell, who will be sentenced tomorrow over a hit-and-run that seriously injured two children, is suing the federal government, alleging police violently treated him during his arrest.

items.title: Four cases of potentially deadly strain of diphtheria confirmed in NT
items.description: The Northern Territory's health department has declared an outbreak of respiratory diphtheria in the Top End.

items.title: Fire-ravaged shire demands fossil fuel companies foot climate disaster bill
items.description: A Victorian council still cleaning up after a bushfire that wiped out more than 50 homes and businesses wants fossil fuel companies to pay for climate disaster recovery.

items.title: Live: ASX slightly down as Iran rejects truce talks
items.description: The ASX 200 is trading slightly down as Iran's foreign minister says the country will not negotiate with the US on a ceasefire plan. Brent crude remains above $US102 a barrel. Follow live

items.title: History-making jockey Michelle Payne honoured with statue at Flemington
items.description: Australian horse racing trailblazer Michelle Payne, the first woman to win the Melbourne Cup, has been honoured with a statue unveiled today.

items.title: Here's who you should see at comedy festivals across Australia
items.description: Comedy season is in full swing, with festivals across the country hosting the best acts from Australia and the world. We asked our favourites to share their recommendations.

items.title: What should you eat to keep your brain sharp as you get older?
items.description: The food choices we make over decades — not just in later life, but across adulthood — may quietly shape the health of our brains in ways that only become visible much later.

items.title: ABC Shakespeare quiz, parteth the seceund: Test thine knowledge once more
items.description: Is this a quiz which you see before you?  We're back with another 10 questions to test your knowledge of William Shakespeare's plays.

items.title: AFL concussion class action expands to more than 100 former players
items.description: Eight more footballers have joined a multimillion-dollar concussion class action against the AFL, tipping the total to over 100 former players who all claim they have been left brain-damaged by the game.

items.title: Socceroos approaching last chance saloon, with World Cup dreams in the balance
items.description: The Socceroos upcoming games against Cameroon and Curaçao could make or shatter World Cup dreams, and Socceroos legend Mark Schwarzer has backed the players, and coach Tony Popovic to deliver come tournament time.

items.title: The NRL risks losing itself in a maze of set restarts
items.description: After three rounds of the NRL season the increase in set restarts has left coaches, players and fans alike more confused than ever about the specifics behind rugby league's most controversial rule change.

items.title: Discerning crocs from logs the challenge for AI trial
items.description: Researchers are trialling artificial intelligence to detect crocodiles in north Queensland waterways, but its success depends on human training to ensure accuracy.

items.title: Savannah Guthrie gives first interview since mother's disappearance
items.description: It is the Today show host's first interview since her mother Nancy was reported missing from her Arizona home on February 1.

items.title: 23yo fronts court over alleged abduction and murder of Chris Baghsarian
items.description: The man who police have alleged to be a "major player" in the mistaken identity kidnapping and murder of a Sydney grandfather, Deklin Donnelly, has fronted court for the first time.

items.title: 'Fight will continue' without change, say ABC workers amid 24-hour strike
items.description: Unions representing ABC staff have signalled the possibility of further strike action if a dispute over pay and conditions at the broadcaster isn't resolved.

items.title: Hard time for renters as landlords squeeze tight market
items.description: Australian renters continue to have a hard time finding a home, despite vacancy rates slowly improving from post COVID pandemic lows, a report finds.
